unknown_numeric_policy: A zero in a schema-required connector, snap, wall-hardware allowance, lead-in, minimum-wall or minimum-ligament field accompanied by dimensions_status is an explicit UNSELECTED sentinel, not an authorized CAD dimension. Parametric source generation shall fail closed until a calculation or named evidence replaces it.

requirements.statement: The unique 600 x 400 mm Berlin artwork shall be manufactured as two permanent 300 x 400 mm main halves with one vertical center seam and no rear grid.
requirements.source: approved design specification 0.3.0 and concept v02
requirements.verification: global bounds, Kobra 3 Max bed-fit report, component audit and assembled flatness test

requirements.statement: One immutable OpenStreetMap-derived Berlin master shall own map registration and feature continuity across the single seam; halves shall never be normalized independently.
requirements.verification: source manifest, global clipping audit and matched seam-coordinate report

requirements.statement: The visible relief shall use at most four broad Urban Signal color bodies without dithering or a realistic map-color claim.
requirements.source: approved design specification 0.3.0 and concept v02
requirements.verification: named-body audit, portable 3MF validation and exact-slicer tool/change/purge report

requirements.statement: Exactly three concealed loose printed one-way spring/tenon connectors and discrete locating lands shall join the halves without glue, magnets, screws or a replaceable service interface.
requirements.source: approved design specification 0.3.0 and user correction
requirements.verification: interface ownership audit, strain calculation, process-matched coupon and one-time assembly test

requirements.statement: Two upper local hanger parts and two lower local standoffs shall snap into isolated rear sockets and create an 18 mm wall gap without a rear frame.
requirements.source: approved isolated snap-in hanger/standoff architecture; count recommended in decomposition 0.3.0
requirements.verification: proxy load-path review, same-process snap coupon, wall-plane gauge and mass-based proof test

requirements.statement: The unlit product shall remain complete while reserving optional customer lighting envelopes for an indirect halo and selected true front-through paths.
requirements.source: approved design specification 0.3.0 and concept v02
requirements.verification: keep-out collision audit, aperture report, lighting gauge and human lit/unlit appearance review

requirements.statement: LEDs, wiring, power supply, controller, diffuser, wall screws and wall anchors are excluded; no electrical-safety or universal wall-load claim shall be made.
requirements.verification: BOM, installation boundary and release-package review

global_style.summary: Abstract architectural Berlin map with restrained relief, broad Urban Signal color fields and sparse luminous paths
global_style.generation_material: four same-family matte PLA colors on a flat-backed printed substrate
global_style.detail_hierarchy: whole-panel composition first, seam-continuous primary routes second, broad semantic fields third, printable minor routes last

assembly_sequence: Print the off-product connector and standoff coupon with the exact production printer, nozzle, material, orientation and profile.
Select and record the passing pocket compensation and flexure candidate; regenerate all mating bodies from the shared interface kit.
Insert the three selected one-way connectors into the left main half, align both halves on a flat fixture and press the right half home once.
Snap two upper hanger parts and two lower standoffs into the isolated rear sockets and verify the 18 mm wall plane.
Optionally add customer lighting only inside the declared rear adhesive lands, strip keep-outs and cable routes.
Install the completed one-piece artwork with substrate-appropriate customer-selected wall hardware and perform the declared proof test.

decision_log.topic: Approve the revision 0.3.0 component, interface, manufacturing and coupon decomposition.

decision_log.topic: Freeze connector spring dimensions, root radius, allowed strain, pocket compensation and one-time retention behavior.
decision_log.current_basis: Topology, quantity and 0.15/0.25/0.35/0.45 mm per-side process-coupon series are approved; no physical material/profile result exists.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Material-specific strain calculation followed by same-process coupon inspection for insertion, whitening/cracks, flushness and destructive pull behavior.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the local hanger/standoff snap geometry and installed proof-load acceptance value.
decision_log.current_basis: Two upper load points plus two lower plane-setting points are the minimal balanced candidate; no wall substrate or physical snap evidence is available.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Same-process snap coupon, completed-artwork mass, actual wall substrate/hardware and installer-owned proof-test plan.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the Berlin OpenStreetMap extraction extent, timestamp, hashes and attribution treatment.
decision_log.current_basis: The approved route is an immutable OSM snapshot clipped once in the global artwork frame.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Local source snapshot, extraction manifest, hashes and reviewed ODbL attribution notice.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the final selected light-through path set.
decision_log.current_basis: Concept v02 approves sparse luminous paths; final geometry depends on the frozen Berlin vector master and declared keep-outs.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Aperture preview, minimum-width/ligament report and physical light-envelope coupon.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the four physical Urban Signal filament spools and transition purge matrix.
decision_log.current_basis: Palette names are approved; supplier products, batches, measured swatches and opacity are not recorded.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Spool/batch identities, swatches, opacity notes and exact-profile directed transition coupon.

decision_log.topic: Select wall-substrate-specific anchors outside the product package.
decision_log.current_basis: The product provides only local hanger geometry; wall substrate and fasteners are customer/installer-specific.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Actual wall substrate, chosen hardware data and installed proof test by the responsible installer.
